bio: Although the extensive choice on the menu includes dishes that you would expect to find in a Japanese restaurant, the quality of the cuisine served here is well above average, with a choice of different types of fish, dumplings, ramen, fried dishes, and ingredients cooked on the yakimono grill – everything comes as a pleasant surprise. And if you’re keen to experience a complete immersion into Japanese cuisine, the 8-course kohaku kaiseki tasting menu served in the evening is the perfect choice....
